summary: Town's current page found (togwy.us; old townofguernseywy.us dead): season April-October and showers confirmed (manual), dump false added (town: 'No dump station available'). Town posts no rate, count or hookups; 15 sites / 50A left derived. Pin fine (~55 m from the gravel RV lot). Not waterfront stands. Website and phone need hand edits. Note cleaned (dropped the count, amps, showers and season it repeated; 'City' -> Town; 'beside' the river -> near).
flags: WEBSITE: dead https://www.townofguernseywy.us/departments/parks___recreation/trail_ruts_golf___camp (no DNS) -> https://www.togwy.us/parks-recreation/ (Town of Guernsey's current site; RV Life links the same page). Do not use golfandcamp.com (campgroundviews lists it; it is an unrelated Texas golf/camping content site).

PHONE: empty -> 307-836-2255 (Trail Ruts Golf Course on the town page's contact block; also Google's 'Larson Park Campground' listing and the operator text on RoverPass). RV Life's 307-881-4316 is Google's separate 'Trail Ruts Golf Course' listing.

FEES (left unset): the town posts no rate ('Reasonable rates', 'weekly camp rates'). Camper reports: Google review ~mid-2026 '$30' for water and electric by phone, dry camping '$20' plus '$25 for water'; ParkAdvisor 2025-08-15 '$35 a day for water and electric'; ParkAdvisor 2021 '$30/night water and electric ... $15/night 30 amp electric only'. RV Life avg $25 ($$). Not written because the operator has a page (rule: camper reports price an entry only when the operator has none). Local campground, so the price gate does not apply.

BOOKING (left unset): by phone, from the operator text on the unclaimed RoverPass listing ('DO NOT MAKE A RESERVATION THROUGH ANY WEBSITE. TO GUARANTEE YOUR RESERVATION PLEASE CALL') and a ~mid-2026 Google review (phoned a reservation). The same reviewer was turned away on arrival because the lot was full ('the area was full of RVs') - one report; nothing else suggests long-stay use, and the town markets weekend/two-week vacation stays.

SITES / HOOKUPS (left derived): count 15 rests on the old town page (now unreadable) and RV Life/The Dyrt; electric 50 on the old town page and The Dyrt ('30/50 amp'). The current town page states neither. Two classes per reviews: water+electric sites on the gravel lot by the office, and cheaper electric-only sites 'on other side of creek down a gravel road' (2021) - the second area could not be placed on imagery.

SEASON: town 'April through October' written (widest dates, marked approximate); RoverPass says Apr 15 - Oct 15. The town page also carries 'Open April – October – Saturday & Sunday' under the Larson Park text - unclear whether that is the pro shop/course or the campground; not used.

PIN: stored 42.2565,-104.7422 sits on the first green ~55 m S of the gravel RV lot centre (~42.25692,-104.74184) - under 250 m, no move needed (optional nudge to the lot). Google's 'Larson Park Campground' point 42.25399,-104.73987 is on a fairway ~340 m SE - do not use it.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' stands. The ~25 m irrigation canal runs beside the lot behind a band of shrubs and trees; the North Platte is ~200 m+ away. A 2021 review picked an electric-only spot 'with a good view of creek' across the canal - unnamed, one report, and there is no creek-view value.

NAME (optional): the town calls it 'Larson Park – Trail Ruts Golf Course' / 'Larson Park, home of Trail Ruts Golf Course and Campground'; Google 'Larson Park Campground'. A cleaner stored name would be 'Larson Park Campground (Trail Ruts Golf Course)'.

INCLUSION_EVIDENCE: the stored text cites the dead town page; suggested replacement: 'Town of Guernsey page (togwy.us/parks-recreation, read 2026-11-20): Larson Park, home of Trail Ruts Golf Course and Campground, RV and tent sites, showers, season April-October; Google Maps Larson Park Campground 4.4 (52) with recent camper reviews of water/electric RV sites on a gravel lot by the pro shop -> real drive-in town RV campground (local)'.

OWNERSHIP: local (Town of Guernsey) confirmed; RV Life tags it 'commercial'. Google ratings: campground 4.4 (52); golf course 4.7 (58, a separate listing). No leads nearby (Guernsey State Park's campgrounds are already in the database).
